title: GET /health — Response Contract
description: Service health and config-load status. Used by Docker Compose healthcheck and Orchestrator dependency gating.

status.description: Service is running and all tools are loaded

tool_count.description: Number of tools currently loaded from config

config_path.description: Absolute path to the tools.yaml file being watched

last_reload.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful config load or hot-reload

503.description: Service degraded — config load failed or tools.yaml is invalid

error.description: English description of the config error

tool_count.description: Number of tools from last valid load (may be 0 on startup failure)

last_reload.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful reload, or null if startup failed
